article.title: Variación según formalidad
article.part: Portugués brasileño real y variación — Português brasileiro real e variação
article.chapter: Variación regional y social en Brasil — Variação regional e social no Brasil

claims.summary: La formalidad influye en qué variantes elige un hablante. Una misma persona puede usar formas distintas en diferentes contextos.
En contextos informales se usan reducciones y formas plenas en escritura formal. La formalidad no es una escala única.
Se muestran ejemplos de uso informal y formal, así como conversacional y formal monitorizado.

links.notes: The article states that the formality influences the choice of variants by a speaker, and that a person can use different forms in different conversations (friends, job interview, official document). This aligns with the source's claim about the influence of formality on language choice.

The article explains that informal contexts use reductions and formal contexts use full forms, and that formality is not a single scale. This matches the source's description of different language forms based on context.

The article provides examples of informal, formal, and conversational forms, as well as a formal monitored example. This aligns with the source's examples of different language forms in different contexts.
